name: HSBC Holdings
title: Annual Results 2025 Presentation to Investors and Analysts - Transcript

read.thesis: Record 2025 PBT $36.6bn and ROTE 17.2%, with new 2026-28 ROTE target of 17%+ and 2026 banking NII of at least $45bn; supply-side levers are cost discipline, not capacity, and the bank is capital-generative but buybacks are paused for up to three quarters post Hang Seng privatisation.

triggers.label: ROTE target 17%+ for 2026-28
triggers.quote: We will target return on tangible equity of 17% or better in each year from 2026 to 2028, excluding notable items

triggers.label: 2026 banking NII at least $45bn
triggers.quote: We expect full-year 2026 banking NII of at least $45 billion

triggers.label: Cost growth held to 1% in 2026
triggers.quote: We expect to constrain cost growth to 1% on a target basis.

triggers.label: Wealth guidance dropped
triggers.quote: we have dropped the guidance on that

guidance.value: Positive each year 2026-28, rising to 5% in 2028

prior_guidance_check.quote: We delivered 3% cost growth on a target basis in 2025, in line with our cost target.
Full-year return on tangible equity was 17.2%, achieving our mid-teens or better target.
We have therefore removed ‘growth fee and other income at a double-digit percentage CAGR’ from our guidance.

red_flags.label: Hong Kong CRE credit-impaired exposure growing
red_flags.quote: this number has grown, and it now stands at $1.9 billion

evasions.quote: we are not guiding beyond our horizon
We look at a few plausible downside scenarios as well before we give full guidance.
